Identified as this saint because: Commons titles the figure Basil of Amasea, cut from the April panel of a 17th-century menaion icon at the Museum of Christian Art in Moscow. Amasea is the see this folder gives him, and the April panel is the month of his feast, 26 April here. Commons describes it: Икона "Минея". Апрель. Центральная Россия, первая четверть XVII века.
